# Homy TP v1.3.0 – Changelog

## New in this release

### New Command: /back
- Added a `/back` command to teleport to your previous location.
- Every time you teleport to a home, your previous location is saved.
- Using `/back` will take you to the location you were at before your last teleport.

### General
- Internal version updated to v1.3.0.
- Minor code cleanup and stability improvements.

---
No breaking changes. Just added /Back command

# Homy TP v1.2.0 – Changelog

## New in this release

### Quality-of-Life Improvements
- Added tab-completion for home names in `/home` and `/removehome`.
- Teleport messages now include the target dimension:
  - Overworld: “Teleporting to Overworld home 'name'...”
  - Nether: “Teleporting to Nether home 'name'...”
  - End: “Teleporting to End home 'name'...”
- `/home` preloads the destination chunk to prevent void/failed teleports.

### New Command: /homy
- Displays version info (now shows dynamically as v1.2.0).
- Clickable links in chat:
  - Community Discord
  - CurseForge
  - GitHub
  - Modrinth: shows “coming soon” (not clickable)

### Admin Command: /ophomes
- Shows player usernames instead of UUIDs when listing homes.

### General
- Internal version updated to v1.2.0.
- README updated with features, commands, and links.
- Minor code cleanup and stability improvements.

---

No breaking changes. Teleports are safer, commands are easier to use, and links are user-friendly in chat.

**Homy TP v1.1.0 – Changelog**

__New in this release__

**/homy Command**
• Added the `/homy` command, which displays:
  - The mod version (**v1.1.0**)
  - A clickable Community Discord link
  - A clickable CurseForge link
  - A GitHub link (clickable)
  - Modrinth link (shows “coming soon”, not clickable)

**/ophomes Command**
• `/ophomes` now displays player usernames instead of UUIDs.

**/home Command**
• The `/home` command now force-loads the destination chunk before teleporting, preventing void/failed teleports.

**/homes Command**
• `/homes` is now accessible to all players (no OP required).

**General**
• Internal version updated to **v1.1.0**.
• Minor code and documentation improvements.

_No breaking changes. All links (except Modrinth) are now user-friendly and clickable in Minecraft chat!_
